resolution.note: canary clean-tree step runs the related subset; perfect-memory clone adopts exit 0 in 8s

title: krn adopt exceeds the canary budget on a slow-test repository (perfect-memory exits 124)
body:
Why: census rerun on HEAD (KRN_CENSUS_CODING=/mnt/storage/coding TMPDIR=/mnt/storage/tmp/census node scripts/adoption-census.ts --write, exit 0, log /mnt/storage/tmp/census/run.log, table evals/adoption-census.md): `krn adopt` on krn/active/perfect-memory (python, HEAD 0ded4f5) exits 124: the canary step "Stop gate on the clean tree" exceeded 180s (176.3s). The other 14 of 15 repos adopt with exit 0.
Outcome: adopt on a slow-test repository either finishes within the canary budget or fails with a deliberate exit and a message naming the step and the way to raise the limit; the Stop-gate canary does not spend its whole budget on a test command that cannot finish.
Proof: krn adopt on a clone of perfect-memory exits 0 or a deliberate non-124 code; a regression test at the canary layer covers a slow test command.
